sloka: अदृश्यानि च भूतानि मुमुचुर्भैरवस्वनम् ।शिश्यरे चाभिभूतानि सम्त्रस्ताम्यद्विजन्ति च ॥६-२२-१३॥।।
transliteration: adṛśyāni ca bhūtāni mumucurbhairavasvanam ।śiśyare cābhibhūtāni samtrastāmyadvijanti ca ॥6-22-13॥।।

translations.english: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.
translations.hindi: जो जीदधारी अदृश्य थे, वे सब भी बड़ा भयङ्कर शब्द करने लगे । बहुत से मारे डर के विकल हो, लेट गए
